summary: SOPHiA GENETICS SA filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten public offering of 10,526,000 ordinary shares (CHF 0.05 nominal value) at $4.75 per share, with a 30-day underwriter option for an additional 1,578,900 shares. The total offering size is approximately $50 million before underwriting discounts. Shares are listed on Nasdaq under SOPH. TD Cowen and Guggenheim Securities act as joint book-running managers. The filing is a standard equity shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5) and does not involve any M&A, activist, or restructuring special situation.
